spinDetectionOverrideDescription.message: Select which spin detection to use in place of the default for the mode

4pointDescription.message: Each piece gets 4 points around it. At least 3 must be filled for a spin. 2 specific points must be filled for a full spin; otherwise, the spin is mini, but only if the first 4 rotations in the offset table are used.

immobileDescription.message: If a piece gets rotated into a position where it cannot move up, down, left, or right, then it is a spin. There are no mini spins.

ezImmobileDescription.message: Same as immobile, but if upon rotating a piece it kicks (rotates, but not on its center-axis) and it does not satisfy the requirements for an immobile spin, then it is a mini spin.

piecePresetsDescription.message: Select from a variety of presets that determine which spins are detected/rewarded for which pieces

presetTspinsDescription.message: Only T-Spins are detected and rewarded

presetAllSpinsDescription.message: All spins are detected and rewarded

presetNoSpinsDescription.message: No spins are detected or rewarded
